subject: reasoning
question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/840bbe7d52cdc3bfe06ea1e73b58846b64b06528e84cfd681bc3b1626a267b4e.png]
solution:
In the given figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/355460fc1bd03c3910238a5346ab18619251184a1a2ff24d05d86b1eb7bf2570.png] 4 triangles are numbered in this figure.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e5599d637dbb6fd226f4ed22bb74eeb695f7247c53bc2d6cd5da636eae5ef4a.png] 2 triangles can be seen in this figure.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d5463d70ea163c97718abdbf7461c90c76afe5b9bc9f96d24c374da1fc1075a.png] 1 triangle is shown here.

Total triangles = 4 + 2 + 1 = 7

Hence **the correct answer is option 2**
